$comment: Documented, time-boxed exceptions for `npm audit`. Everything NOT listed
here still fails CI at --audit-level=high. Each entry must state why the
advisory is unreachable in OUR architecture and carry a review date.
An expired or no-longer-reported entry makes the audit script fail loudly,
so this file cannot silently rot.

allow.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
allow.justification: Requires React Router RSC (React Server Components) mode. HOCKIA is a pure client-side SPA: Vite build, <BrowserRouter>, no SSR, no framework mode, no RSC entry points (verified 2026-07-25 — zero references to RSC/createStaticHandler/@react-router/serve). The vulnerable code path is never loaded. The only npm-offered 'fix' is a DOWNGRADE to react-router-dom@7.11.0, which would reintroduce GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 (open redirect in Link/useNavigate) — strictly worse. Real fix is react-router@8.3.0, which requires migrating off react-router-dom (no v8 of that package) across ~182 files; tracked as a separate planned upgrade.
